modelProposalBoundary.description: Model/AUTO may propose relationship candidates only. Canonical edges require admitted evidence and MDBO resolution.

capabilities.sufficiency: Admitted source artifacts with entity and relationship claims
capabilities.verificationContract: Source bytes, adapter coordinates, and verification basis remain exact

capabilities.sufficiency: Correlated entity identities from the same candidate input
capabilities.verificationContract: Endpoint keys resolve to exactly one admitted entity or remain unresolved

capabilities.sufficiency: Evidence-backed relationship claims with resolved endpoints
capabilities.verificationContract: Verification basis separate from correlation outcome; provenance retained on each edge

capabilities.sufficiency: Complete registration candidate with admitted entities and edges
capabilities.verificationContract: Fail closed on cycles, duplicates, missing endpoints, and cross-game conflicts

capabilities.sufficiency: Verified candidate and explicit navigation context
capabilities.verificationContract: Prepared paths derive from admitted hierarchy edges only; alternate views and filters remain separate

capabilities.sufficiency: Validated catalog payload and exact Location correlation keys
capabilities.verificationContract: Native identity and primary terminology correlation without display-name merge
